faq.q: Can I track things that aren't simple yes/no habits?
faq.a: Yes. Each habit has a type: Yes/No, Countable (e.g. glasses of water with a daily target), or Time-based (minutes). Count and time habits only count as 'done' once you reach the target you set. You can also give each habit an emoji, a colour, and an optional reminder time.

faq.q: How are streaks counted for an 'X times per week' habit?
faq.a: Weekly-scheduled habits are judged per calendar week, not per day. A week counts toward the streak once you hit the times-per-week target (default 3), so hitting 3/3 every week builds a weekly streak rather than resetting. Daily and specific-day habits count consecutive scheduled days instead, and the tracker shows both current and best (longest) streaks.

faq.q: Where is my data stored and can I export it?
faq.a: Everything is saved locally under the habit_tracker_v2 key in your browser — nothing is uploaded. You can 'Export CSV' for a spreadsheet (a date grid of all habits plus a summary of streaks and 30-day completion rate), 'Copy today' to share today's progress as text, or export/import a full JSON backup from the Data tab.

faq.q: What do the Heatmap and Stats tabs show?
faq.a: The Heatmap is a GitHub-style 12-week grid, one combined view plus one per habit, shaded by how much you completed each day. The Stats tab shows your best day of the week over the last 90 days, a 7-day weekly completion bar chart, and a per-habit table of current streak, best streak, 7-day and 30-day completion rates, and total completions.
